findings.claim: Original directly invoked 00406AB0 returns across A,A,B,B,C,C,A,A in one persistent original-created/VCF-attached/registered bus or GTSi emulator, retaining all 118 camera dwords and both measured smoothing regions. Controlled translation produces exact source-origin delta (10,20,30); controlled root rotation rotates the original attachment offset. All valid sampled six-double outputs are finite; the fixed origin and changing basis/corners are distinguished.
findings.limitations: Original-instruction emulation with documented OS/CRT/resource/trig/ftol/ancillary substitutes. Controlled constructed-root poses, runtime velocity, timers and direct camera entry; not native physics, original selected-post or scheduler. Known constructor x87/optional-geometry warnings remain. No hardware x87 parity, M06 mission scene, visibility, pixels, canonical promotion or RND-v1 closure.
